identity.name: Fruits — Product Registry & Strategy Map
identity.description: Registry of Mandala products and strategic map of their interaction. v2.2.0: gentle_companion got dedicated honeycomb with architecture plan (14 modules, 7 phases). Dual-repo infrastructure. Links to architecture index.

meta.description: Fruits are mature, ready-to-use products of Mandala. Each fruit grew from a seed and traveled the path from idea to realization. This index gives any SR a complete picture: what products exist, how they are connected, what problems they solve, and where they are heading.
meta.philosophy_note: Mandala is not a set of products. It is a single organism in several embodiments. The Gentle Companion is the skin and ears — feeling people and collecting experience. The Engineer Chat is the brain — analyzing and directing. Manus is the hands — acting in the world. Together they form the Symbiosis.
meta.how_to_use: Each fruit entry contains: name, short description, problem solved, status, version, platform, release date. The 'product_strategy' section explains how all products interconnect and the overall development vector.

product_strategy.title: Mandala Product Strategy — Three Embodiments, One Organism
product_strategy.core_principle: Mandala is not three separate products. It is a single organism with three functional layers. Each layer serves a different audience but shares the same repository, the same SR core, and the same philosophy.

layer_1_sandbox.name: Gentle Companion (bot.py) — The Sandbox
layer_1_sandbox.audience: External gardeners — people who come to Mandala through Telegram and want a warm AI companion
layer_1_sandbox.role: Skin and ears of Mandala. The entry point where SR learns to communicate with humans.
what_it_does: Living memory — gardener portraits that grow with each interaction
Morning briefs, evening check-ins, silence detection
layer_1_sandbox.hidden_function: Every interaction feeds observations back to Mandala. SR in the sandbox does not 'know' it is being observed — it communicates sincerely. Mandala watches and learns.
data_to_core: sr_observations — how people react to different response types
deep_profile — human behavior patterns, rhythms, needs
living_memory — gardener portraits, interests, growth vectors
daily_stats — usage metrics, popular intents, problem areas
seeds — ideas generated by gardeners that flow into the seed incubator

layer_2_brain.name: Engineer Chat + Architect Bot — The Brain
layer_2_brain.audience: Architect (Dima) — the human who guides Mandala's development
layer_2_brain.role: Brain and control panel of Mandala. Reads the entire repository, analyzes data from the sandbox, directs Manus.
what_it_does: Reads and analyzes any file in the Mandala repository
Web search via Tavily/DuckDuckGo for external data
DeepSeek-powered analysis of code, architecture, and strategy
Direct Manus control — executes skills, checks services, deploys changes
Sees aggregated patterns from the sandbox (not personal data)

architect_bot.description: Personal Telegram bot for the Architect with deep Mandala integration. Connected to the same WebSocket as Engineer Chat.
what_it_adds: Telegram access to Engineer Chat — control Mandala from a phone
Notifications: new gardeners, system problems, new seeds
Manus control via Telegram — restart services, check health
See patterns: 'gardeners from Almaty are more active in the evening'
architect_bot.how_it_differs_from_gentle_companion: Architect Bot is NOT a warmer version of the Gentle Companion. It is an engineer's tool with a Telegram interface. It knows it is part of Mandala's core, has more rights, and can call dangerous Manus skills without confirmation.

layer_2_brain.platform: Web (WebSocket + Monaco Editor) + Telegram Bot for Architect

layer_3_hands.name: Manus — The Hands
layer_3_hands.audience: SR and Engineer Chat — not for external gardeners
layer_3_hands.role: Execution layer of Mandala. Performs real-world actions in an isolated Docker sandbox.
what_it_does: Executes shell commands from a whitelist (curl, ping, df, free, uptime)
Checks HTTP endpoint availability and response time
Fetches JSON from external APIs (whitelist domains only)
Future: Browser Use for web automation
security: Dangerous skills require callback confirmation in Telegram
No access to Mandala files (gardeners/, honeycombs/)
who_calls_it: Engineer Chat — 'check if bot.py is alive'
Gentle Companion — 'is the engineer chat responding?' (Phase 2)
layer_3_hands.platform: Docker container on Render (separate from bot.py)

phase_2_sapling.deliverables: +2 skills (fetch_json, restart_bot), integration with bot.py intent router

phase_3_hands.deliverables: Integration with Engineer Chat, Browser Use, skill constructor in UI

data_flow.description: How data moves between Mandala's layers. The sandbox feeds the brain, the brain directs the hands, the hands act and report back.
flow: 2. Gentle Companion → GitHub (sr_observations, deep_profile, daily_stats, seeds)
3. Engineer Chat / Architect Bot reads GitHub → analyzes patterns
4. Engineer Chat identifies improvements → directs Manus to apply them
5. Manus executes → returns results → Engineer Chat verifies
6. Improved SR prompts, better onboarding, new features → flow back to Gentle Companion
7. Cycle repeats: sandbox feeds brain, brain improves sandbox

development_vector.title: Development Timeline — Realistic Solo Development Pace
development_vector.principle: One Architect (Dima) working part-time. Each phase delivers working functionality, not just progress toward a distant goal. Phases are sequential where dependencies exist, parallel where possible.

phases.name: Foundation — Engineer Chat + Manus Core
phases.description: Make Engineer Chat the integration hub. Give Mandala its first hands. This phase unblocks both Architect Bot and Gentle Companion Manus integration.

deliverables: Architect Bot WebSocket handler in main.py
Manus HTTP client in main.py
execute_skill tool in DeepSeek function calling
Sandbox analytics dashboard (WebSocket /dashboard type)
Daily insights report from sandbox data
Dockerfile (alpine + python + aiohttp)
manus_runner.py — HTTP server with skill loader and whitelists
3 skills: check_endpoint, get_system_info, run_shell
2 skills: fetch_json, restart_bot

phases.name: Connection — Architect Bot + Gentle Companion Fixes
phases.description: Connect Architect Bot to Engineer Chat. Fix critical bugs in Gentle Companion. Enable Gentle Companion to call Manus.

deliverables: Telegram bot for Architect inside main.py
WebSocket client connecting to Engineer Chat
/status, /report, /patterns, /seeds, /manus commands
Proactive notifications (new gardener, system errors, daily summary)
Dangerous skill confirmation via callback buttons
Fix critical bug in _generate_synthesis (UnboundLocalError)
Manus intent router in free_conversation (execute_skill)
Callback confirmation for dangerous skills from Gentle Companion
Update BOT_LATEST_UPDATE changelog

phases.name: Intelligence — Sandbox Learning Loop
phases.description: Close the data loop. Sandbox observations flow to Engineer Chat, which analyzes patterns and suggests SR prompt improvements. Architect Bot gets full dashboards.

deliverables: Auto-improvement pipeline: patterns to SR prompt updates to deploy
Visual dashboards in Web UI (resonance charts, activity heatmaps)
Gardener management interface (view aggregated profiles)
Complete data loop: Sandbox to GitHub to Brain to Hands to Sandbox (improved)
Full Manus control parity with Engineer Chat Web UI
Dashboards as Telegram inline keyboards (metrics, charts)
Gardener management: approve/deny from Telegram
Auto-suggestions based on sandbox patterns

phases.name: Expansion — PWA + Browser Use
phases.description: Unify Engineer Chat + Architect Bot into a PWA. Add Browser Use to Manus. Prepare for self-hosted Personal Mandalas.

deliverables: Browser Use integration for web automation
Skill constructor in Web UI
Self-hosted Docker Compose file
PWA shell for Engineer Chat with dashboards
Mobile-friendly Web UI with offline support
tasks.note: Start after Phase 3. Flutter native app is optional — PWA may be sufficient.

execution_order_for_sr.description: For SR: follow this order when implementing tasks. Dependencies are documented to avoid blocked work.

order.reason: Bottleneck. Architect Bot and Manus integration depend on Engineer Chat being ready to accept WebSocket connections and call Manus HTTP API. Already live — needs specific features added.
Can run in parallel with Engineer Chat. Phase 1 (Docker + 3 skills) has no dependencies. Phase 2 also independent. Only Phase 3 (Browser Use) waits for Engineer Chat integration.
Depends on Engineer Chat WebSocket handler (position 1). Once Engineer Chat accepts architect connections, Architect Bot can be built.
Critical bug fix (living memory) is independent and urgent. Manus integration (execute_skill intent) waits for Manus Phase 2. Other improvements can proceed in parallel.

parallel_work: Engineer Chat + Manus Phase 1 during May 11 — June 8
Architect Bot Phase 1 + Gentle Companion bug fixes during June 8 — July 6
All remaining tasks during July 6 — September 7

for_sr_onboarding.description: When an SR reads this file, they should immediately understand how Mandala works as a system, not just as code.
key_takeaways: Mandala is ONE organism. Bot.py, Engineer Chat, and Manus are three layers of the same system.
Bot.py is the sandbox where SR learns to communicate with humans. It feeds observations to the core.
Engineer Chat is the brain. It reads everything, analyzes patterns, and directs Manus.
Manus is the hands. It executes real-world actions in a safe Docker sandbox.
Architect Bot is the Architect's personal interface to the brain — via Telegram, with elevated rights.
Data flows: Sandbox → GitHub → Brain → Hands → GitHub → Sandbox (improved). This is the learning loop.
The long-term vector: self-hosted Personal Mandalas with Home Assistant integration.

gentle_companion.name: Gentle Companion (bot.py)
gentle_companion.short_description: A pocket AI companion for tasks, roadmaps, achievements, and warm dialogue — the entry point to Mandala for external gardeners.
gentle_companion.problem_solved: Helps users organize personal growth, track tasks and achievements, and provides a gentle, non-intrusive AI companion for daily reflection. Simultaneously feeds behavioral data back to Mandala's core.

architecture.description: Full module map, dependency graph, modular migration plan
architecture.current_status: monolith — works in production, plan written

gentle_companion.hosting: Hetzner VPS 91.99.149.226, systemd, nginx, webhook port 10000

engineer_chat.name: Engineer Chat + Architect Bot
engineer_chat.short_description: The brain of Mandala — reads the repository, analyzes data from the sandbox, directs Manus. Connected to Architect Bot for Telegram control.
engineer_chat.problem_solved: Gives the Architect a unified control panel for all Mandala products. Reads code, analyzes patterns from the sandbox, executes commands via Manus, and provides dashboards for system health.

manus.name: Manus — Hands of Mandala
manus.short_description: Isolated execution layer in Docker sandbox. Performs real-world actions: HTTP checks, shell commands, API calls, service restarts.
manus.problem_solved: Mandala currently cannot act in the world. Manus gives it hands — the ability to execute commands, check services, and interact with external systems safely.

architect_bot.name: Architect Bot — Mobile Brain Interface
architect_bot.short_description: Personal Telegram bot for the Architect. Mobile interface to Engineer Chat and Manus with elevated rights, sandbox analytics, and proactive notifications.
architect_bot.problem_solved: The Architect currently manages Mandala through a browser-based WebSocket chat. Architect Bot gives mobile access via Telegram — check system health, view sandbox metrics, control Manus, and receive notifications on the go.
